question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. "Electrolite."

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is 'Electrolyte.'
 
• 'Electrolyte' means a liquid that electricity can go through or that breaks into its parts when electricity goes through it. (एक तरल जिसके माध्यम से बिजली जा सकती है या जो बिजली के माध्यम से जाने पर उसके हिस्सों में टूट जाती है)
 
• Therefore, 'Electrolite' is incorrectly spelt among the given options.
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
